sample_median_depth_patch: sample the median depth value from a patch around a pixel in a raw depth image
project_3d_points_to_pixel_uv: project 3D XYZ points to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics
compute_3d_point_from_pixel: compute a single 3D point from a pixel coordinate and depth value using camera intrinsics
compute_batch_3d_points_from_pixels: compute multiple 3D points from arrays of pixel coordinates and depth values using camera intrinsics
extract_best_depth_from_detection_bbox: extract the best depth value and center coordinates from a detection bounding box in a depth image
